summary: The Newark Museum of Art (NMOA) has agreed to restore ownership of a large brown jug made in 1852 by the enslaved South Carolina potter David Drake, also known as Dave the Potter, to the artist’s descendants. title: The Phillips Collection Receives Its Largest Ever Individual Gift
summary: The Philips Collection in Washington D.C has received its largest ever individual gift. The $10 million donation comes from the Beatriz and Graham Bolton Global Vision Fund. summary: The National Gallery of Art has announced part two of its Across the Nation lending program, which will bring masterworks from its collection across the United States.
